actions.script:
const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const enc = (text) => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''') // the find: as given (find=Y, or a scope or text in the URL), else the session's last const key = 'bossContactsFind' const session = (() => { try { return ec.web ? ec.web.sessionAttributes : null } catch (err) { return null } })() let saved = {} try { saved = JSON.parse(session?.get(key) || '{}') || {} } catch (err) { saved = {} } const given = find === 'Y' || !!scope || text != null || !!combinedName || !!letter || !!contactBookGroupId const state = given ? {scope: scope || 'all', contactBookGroupId: contactBookGroupId || null, text: (text != null ? text : combinedName) || null, letter: letter || null} : Object.assign({scope: 'all', contactBookGroupId: null, text: null, letter: null}, saved) if (given) { try { session?.put(key, JSON.stringify(state)) } catch (err) { ec.logger.info("Contacts: the find is not kept: " + err) } } findScope = state.scope findGroupId = state.contactBookGroupId findText = state.text || '' findLetter = state.letter || '' const isPrint = sri.getRenderMode() == 'html-print' const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.ContactServices.find#ContactRows').parameters({scope: findScope, contactBookGroupId: findGroupId, text: findText || null, letter: findLetter || null, limit: isPrint ? 200 : 50}).call() || {} findScope = out.scope || 'all' const rows = Array.from(out.rowList || []) book = out.contactBook || null const books = Array.from(out.contactBookList || []) scopeOptions = out.scopeOptions || [] rowCount = out.rowCount || 0 hasMore = !!out.hasMore shownCount = rows.length filtered = !!(findText || findLetter || findGroupId) isContactAdmin = ec.user.hasPermission('CONTACT_ADMIN') || ec.user.isInGroup('BOSS_CONTACT_ADMIN') || ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') // side by side the first row fills the main pane; stacked, no selection shows the list alone recordPartyId = partyId || (rows.length ? rows[0].partyId : null) inSplit = true recordBase = '/qapps/Commons/Contacts' const avatarBase = sri.buildUrl('contactAvatar').path contactRows = rows.map((row) => { const selected = row.partyId === recordPartyId const image = row.hasFaceImage ? ' image="' + enc(avatarBase + '?partyId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.partyId)) + '"' : '' const second = [row.emailAddress, row.phone].filter((part) => part).join(' · ') const icon = row.isPersonal ? '' + enc(L('Personal: only you see it')) + '' : '' const star = row.isFavorite ? '' : '' return Object.assign({}, row, {rowHtml: '
' + '' + '
' + enc(row.name) + '' + star + icon + '
' + (row.subtitle ? '
' + enc(row.subtitle) + '
' : '') + (second ? '
' + enc(second) + '
' : '') + '
'}) }) // the chips of a book's groups, with All const groups = book ? Array.from(book.groupList || []) : [] groupChips = book ? [{id: '', label: L('All') + ' · ' + (book.partyCount || 0), on: !findGroupId}].concat(groups.map((group) => ({id: group.contactBookGroupId, label: group.groupName + ' · ' + (group.partyCount || 0), on: group.contactBookGroupId === findGroupId}))) : [] letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.split('').map((ch) => ({letter: ch, on: ch === findLetter})) // the books and groups a bulk action may put contacts in editableBooks = books.filter((entry) => ['CbpEdit', 'CbpManage'].includes(entry.permissionEnumId)) bookChoices = editableBooks.map((entry) => ({key: entry.contactBookId, text: entry.contactBookName + (entry.isOwner ? '' : ' · ' + L('shared'))})) groupChoices = editableBooks.flatMap((entry) => Array.from(entry.groupList || []).map((group) => ({key: group.contactBookGroupId, text: entry.contactBookName + ' · ' + group.groupName}))) bookScopeEditable = !!book && ['CbpEdit', 'CbpManage'].includes(book.permissionEnumId) emptyText = filtered ? L('No contacts match') : (book || findScope === 'mine' ? L('No contacts yet · Import or add one') : L('No contacts')) // Print: this find as a contact sheet printUrl = '/apps/Commons/Contacts/List?' + Object.entries({renderMode: 'html-print', find: 'Y', scope: findScope, contactBookGroupId: findGroupId, text: findText || null, letter: findLetter || null}).filter(([, value]) => value != null && value !== '') .map(([name, value]) => encodeURIComponent(name) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value)).join('&') printMode = isPrint if (isPrint) { const scopeText = (scopeOptions.find((option) => option.key === findScope) || {}).text || '' const cell = (text) => '' + enc(text) + '' printHtml = '
' + enc(L('Contacts')) + (scopeText ? ' · ' + enc(scopeText) : '') + (findText ? ' · ' + enc(findText) : '') + (findLetter ? ' · ' + enc(findLetter) : '') + '
' + '' + rows.map((row) => '' + cell(row.name) + cell(row.subtitle || row.organizationName) + cell(row.emailAddress) + cell(row.phone) + '').join('') + '
' + enc(L('Name')) + '' + enc(L('Organization')) + '' + enc(L('Email')) + '' + enc(L('Phone')) + '
' + (hasMore ? '

' + enc(L('The first') + ' ' + rows.length + ' ' + L('of') + ' ' + rowCount) + '

' : '') } newContactHtml = ''
